name: pyconjp2026-keynote
description: Slides and materials for Takashi Kitao's PyCon JP 2026 keynote

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/check.js
scripts.format: prettier scripts tests src package.json wrangler.jsonc playwright.config.js .github/workflows/check.yml README.md --write
scripts.format:check: prettier scripts tests src package.json wrangler.jsonc playwright.config.js .github/workflows/check.yml README.md --check
scripts.predeploy: npm run check && npm run test:browser
scripts.deploy:check: npm run check && node scripts/cloudflare.js deploy --dry-run
